headline: First Light | Pharmaceuticals, Kalyan Jewellers

highlights: On MAT basis, IPM reported value growth of 11.3% and unit growth of 1.7%. ▪ Gastro therapy reported highest value growth of 14%, surpassing IPM growth from last three consecutive months. ▪ We believe IPM would report double-digit growth in CY27 too, led by price hikes and new product launches.

KALYAN JEWELLERS ▪ India SSSG stood at 16%, indicating healthy same-store demand despite elevated gold prices. ▪ Studded jewellery continued to gain traction, contributing ~31% to India jewellery revenue, supporting healthy profitability ▪ Continued shift towards organised retail and studded jewellery supports market-share gains and growth Click here for the full report.
